# Included Maré design material

`components.js` is the readable React component distribution from the Maré Design System revision recorded in `provenance.json`. Its corresponding styles, mark, sand SVG and fonts live under `web/vendor/`.

The Maré-owned copies are MIT licensed for distribution with this launcher. Font OFL licences remain in `licenses/`; this does not relicense the upstream design-system repository. Keep provenance current when intentionally updating copied material. The launcher has one implementation and does not fetch the upstream repository at build time.
